title: Low-Glycemic Green Goddess Power Salad
description: Kale and pumpkin seeds supply magnesium and phytosterols, which compete with dietary cholesterol absorption in the gut. The monounsaturated fats from avocado enhance the bioavailability of fat-soluble antioxidant carotenoids.
diabeticNotes: Kale and pumpkin seeds supply magnesium and phytosterols, which compete with dietary cholesterol absorption in the gut. The monounsaturated fats from avocado enhance the bioavailability of fat-soluble antioxidant carotenoids.

ingredients.name: grilled chicken breast, thinly sliced across the grain
chopped dinosaur / lacinato kale (stems removed, massaged)
extra virgin olive oil for massaging kale

steps.title: Blend Green Goddess Dressing
steps.description: Blend Greek yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, and a quarter of the avocado until creamy and smooth.

steps.title: Massage Chopped Kale
steps.description: Place chopped kale in a large bowl. Drizzle olive oil and massage leaves with hands for 1 minute until tender.

steps.title: Toss Greens with Dressing
steps.description: Add sliced cucumber to massaged kale and toss with 2 tablespoons of prepared green goddess dressing.

steps.title: Add Chicken & Avocado
steps.description: Top dressed greens with sliced grilled chicken breast and remaining diced avocado.

steps.title: Garnish with Pumpkin Seeds
steps.description: Scatter raw pumpkin seeds over top for a healthy crunch and serve immediately.
